scope: Reused three-study development evaluation; no Parse queries or targets used
kernel: study-weighted centered RBF; exp(-mean squared control distance/(2*median training pair distance)); median recomputed in every inner and outer training fold; zero median fallback 1
selection: equal-study mean inner MSE; ties strongest penalty; no scale tuning
gate: at least 5 percent lower equal-donor mean RMSE than both unchanged baselines in each held-out study
